newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat March new car registrations up 22.7pct.
newsitem.headline: Fiat March new car registrations up 22.7pct.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat saw a rise of 22.7 percent in its group March new car registrations in Italy to 96,020 vehicles from 78,278 in March 1996.
The Fiat group includes the Alfa Romeo, Fiat-Innocenti and Lancia Autobianchi marques.

Alfa Romeo saw a 3.10 percent rise in new registration in March from March 1996 to 6,830, Fiat-Innocenti was up 35.68 percent to 78,670 and Lancia Autobianchi was 4.77 percent higher at 10,520, Italian Ministry of Transport figures showed.
In March, total Italian new car registrations rose 25.04 percent to 220,500 compared to March 1996.
